title: Assurance Signal Fabric — regional control mapping & automated collector hub
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a pluggable ‘Signal Fabric’ service that maps compliance controls (SOC 2 / ISO 27001) to concrete telemetry, artifacts, and regional retention rules, and exposes an automated collector hub to produce auditor-ready bundles. The fabric should: 1) allow per-region control-to-artifact mappings (e.g., access logs, change approvals, KMS rotations) with retention directives, 2) normalize artifact metadata (hashing, provenance, canonical timestamps), 3) provide collector adapters (S3, BigQuery, DB snapshots, runtime traces) and an output packager that produces tamper-evident bundles with manifest and signature, and 4) surface endpoints for auditors and internal SOC workflows (export, query, attest).
acceptance_criteria: Control catalog UI + API that maps 30+ SOC 2 / ISO controls to artifact types and required retention per region
Collector adapters for: object store (S3/GCS), DB snapshot exporter, runtime trace slicer, and RBAC event stream (Kafka) that can be wired in via config
Automated packaging pipeline that produces a signed bundle (manifest + SHA256 index) and stores checksum in regional ledger
E2E test demonstrating that a request for a control audit in eu-west-1 returns a bundle with correct regional retention and redaction markers
Docs + runbook for on-call to handle collector failures and manual bundle re-creation
tasks: Design control->artifact schema and retention field (PM + Security)
Implement metadata normalizer and hashing pipeline (ENG)
Build console UI for mapping and per-region overrides (DES + PM)
Add audit export API and signer using customer KMS integration
Run privacy review and redaction policy mapping with legal/security

2025-03-05 | Aisha Patel: PM decision — prioritize EU and US regions for MVP retention enforcement; APAC to follow in Q3. Aim to support auditors with read-only signed bundle exports rather than direct DB access.
decision_log: 2025-02-25 | Decided to represent retention as two fields: retention_period (ISO8601) and storage_region_constraint (list of region tags). This enables both temporal and geofence semantics.
2025-03-02 | Decided to standardize artifact manifests using JSON-LD with explicit provenance fields (actor, action, object, timestamp, canonical_hash).
2025-03-04 | Chose SHA-256 for bundle indexing and ledger recording. Plan to put ledger entries into region-local KVs + replicate checksums to central verification service.
current_blockers: KMS/HSM integration design pending — Security to provide HSM signing flow (blocker for final bundle signer)
Need capacity plan for chunked DB snapshot service (eng infra dependency)
notes: Trade-offs: tight regional residency enforcement increases complexity for cross-region analytics. Proposal: allow auditor bundles with controlled export provenance rather than full cross-region replication for MVP.
Operational: collector failures should auto-enqueue re-ingestion jobs and alert on a per-control basis to avoid noisy paging for low-risk controls.
Privacy: include automated redaction markers and a redaction runbook for PII artifacts before bundling. Legal to provide regex rules and sampling guide.
